description: One Anthropic message whose usage includes cache read and cache write, traced by OpenLLMetry.
notes: TRACELOOP_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so message content is recorded on spans as gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages. TRACELOOP_METRICS_ENABLED is false. ANTHROPIC_OPEN_TELEMETRY is false, which turns off the Anthropic SDK's own spans. These provider packages have no TRACELOOP_TELEMETRY switch and no vendor export URL; spans go through the harness tracer provider. gen_ai.prompt.N is not written. The system prompt is marked cache_control ephemeral. Scripted usage is input 2100, output 40, cache_read 1800, cache_write 200, so Anthropic's raw input_tokens is 100. The instrumentor adds the cache counts back, so gen_ai.usage.input_tokens is 2100, with cache_read.input_tokens 1800 and cache_creation.input_tokens 200. Covers D113 (OpenLLMetry Anthropic token semantics).

message.text: It is 18 °C and sunny in Paris.
